$comment: Intentional, reviewed deltas between this repo's vendored src/core/ and the GKOS Engine
at the declared parity tag. scripts/check-core-drift.mjs fails CI on any difference not
described here. Fingerprints are sha256 over the normalised unified diff (file headers and
@@ line numbers stripped, semver literals collapsed to <SEMVER> so version bumps do not
churn this file). To re-baseline after an intentional change: run the checker, copy the
printed 'actual fingerprint', and update the reason to match.
notVendored/liteOnly are empty at v1.0.7: the engine gained intelligence.ts and desktop-agent.ts only after this parity tag. If the parity tag moves forward, declare them there.

graph.ts.reason: Doc-comment delta only: Lite keeps the shorter pre-v1.0.6 doc comments on parseSourceFile and buildGraph. Code identical.

incremental.ts.reason: Import-order delta only: the type-only Okf23ProjectionOptions import sits after the ./paths import. Code identical.

okf-migration.ts.reason: Frozen-core path comment plus selective GKOS-Engine v1.2.0 data-integrity backport: unasserted and contested states migrate to hypothesis; only accepted migrates to fact.

okf23.ts.reason: Product identity and exported sensitivity vocabulary, plus selective GKOS-Engine v1.2.0 data-integrity backport preserving refines/blocks/documents relations and their inverse projections.

types.ts.reason: Product identity: OkfAssessment.assessor.id is typed as the literal "tool:kosmos-oden" to match okf23.ts.

version.ts.reason: Product identity: Lite's own version constants (KOSMOS_VERSION / KOSMOS_NAME = vault-kosmos-oden) replace the engine's ENGINE_VERSION / ENGINE_NAME. KOSMOS_VERSION is this plugin's single source of truth (see scripts/check-versions.mjs); the semver literal is normalised out of the fingerprint so releases do not churn this entry.
